metadata.title: The Amplitude Law: a candidate two-field completion for a horizon-derived MOND scale, and the solar-system obstruction that blocks it

creators.name: Zimmerman, Carl
creators.affiliation: Briar Creek Tech, Charlotte, North Carolina, USA

metadata.description:
The acceleration scale a0 = κc√(GρΛ) = 9.3619×10-11 m/s2 (with κ = 1/2 fitted, not derived) reproduces the observed MOND scale from the cosmological constant alone. This paper asks what field theory, if any, makes the corresponding halo density ρ = √(GMba0)/(4πGr2) a dynamical consequence rather than an initial condition.

Results. (1) The equation-of-state route is not the binding constraint: in the weak field the anisotropy pr-pt is unobservable, an exact flat direction of the two lensing observables, so the constraint is the amplitude. (2) Every static single k-essence scalar obeys pt = -ρ identically for any kinetic function, closing that class as a stress carrier; the framework's own shift-symmetric condensate escapes it. (3) The general khronon fails by a scaling theorem, because a0 cannot be built from c and G alone. (4) Of six candidate mechanisms under adversarial verification, one survives: a two-field lock whose mediator Gauss law plus a pointwise balance yields, for any free function and with no interpolation invoked, GMχ(r)/r2 = gobs - gbar as an identity — the real dark mass equals the phantom mass as a theorem. The resulting profile has coefficient 0.9999975 and d ln(coef)/d ln Mb = 0.500000, with screening keyed structurally on the local total field gradient.

This is not a completed field theory. The surviving mechanism's baryon sector is AQUAL as a PDE identity in full generality, so it inherits the modified-gravity solar-system liability: the Cassini quadrupole is 6.7-7.3× the published ceiling, +18σ at face value with an honest floor of >=3σ once the Milky Way mass-model spread is admitted. The cosmological leg is untested, ghost-freedom is uncomputed, clusters remain short by ~2×, and κ = 1/2 remains fitted. Two candidate repairs are identified and neither is computed. Reported as a candidate completion with a live obstruction.

All load-bearing claims are backed by committed scripts that exit zero, produced under adversarial verification in which independent agents were instructed to refute each claim, with manufacturing a deficit penalised as heavily as manufacturing a win.
metadata.notes: kappa = 1/2 is FITTED, not derived. All numbers are quoted on both the canonical (a0 = 9.3619e-11 m/s^2) and alternative (1.1279e-10 m/s^2) footings. The paper reports a candidate completion carrying a live 3-18 sigma solar-system failure; it does not claim closure.
